title: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika

lines.say: Heetoh Heetoh no Mee, Model: Neeka. The Human-Human Fruit. The fruit the World Government feared so much... they erased its name.
lines.show: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika. The Human-Human Fruit. The fruit the World Government feared so much... they erased its name.

lines.say: For eight hundred years, they hunted it. And for eight hundred years, it got away.
lines.show: For 800 years, they hunted it. And for 800 years, it got away.

lines.say: The Five Elders even wondered... does this fruit have a will of its own?
lines.show: The Five Elders even wondered... does this fruit have a will of its own?

lines.say: So they buried the truth. On paper, it became the Gohmoo Gohmoo no Mee. Just a silly rubber fruit.
lines.show: So they buried the truth. On paper, it became the Gomu Gomu no Mi. Just a silly rubber fruit.

lines.say: When they finally caught it, secret agents guarded it on a government ship. Big mistake. Red-Haired Shanks raided the ship, and stole it.
lines.show: When they finally caught it, secret agents guarded it on a government ship. Big mistake. Red-Haired Shanks raided the ship, and stole it.

lines.say: The pirates kept it in a little chest. And a kid named Luffy? He ate it. As dessert.
lines.show: The pirates kept it in a little chest. And a kid named Luffy? He ate it. As dessert.

lines.say: Everyone thought it was just rubber. Stretchy. Bouncy. Bulletproof.
lines.show: Everyone thought it was just rubber. Stretchy. Bouncy. Bulletproof.

lines.say: Until it awakened. His heartbeat started pounding like the Drums of Liberation, and his hair and clothes turned white.
lines.show: Until it awakened. His heartbeat started pounding like the Drums of Liberation, and his hair and clothes turned white.

lines.say: This was the power of Neeka, the Sun God. The warrior of liberation, who frees people from their chains.
lines.show: This was the power of Nika, the Sun God. The warrior of liberation, who frees people from their chains.

lines.say: Now he turns the ground into rubber and fights like a living cartoon. The only limit? His imagination.
lines.show: Now he turns the ground into rubber and fights like a living cartoon. The only limit? His imagination.

lines.say: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
lines.show: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
